WITH grouped_scanspatial AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scanspatial
  GROUP BY arcref
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_records
  FROM grouped_scanspatial
),
pairs_with_total AS (
  SELECT 
    g.arcref,
    g.record_count,
    t.total_records,
    CAST(g.record_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_records as count_ratio
  FROM grouped_scanspatial g
  CROSS JOIN total_sum t
  WHERE t.total_records IS NOT NULL
),
average_count_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count
  FROM pairs_with_total
),
pairs_with_average AS (
  SELECT 
    p.record_count,
    p.count_ratio,
    p.record_count - a.avg_record_count as count_diff,
    a.avg_record_count
  FROM pairs_with_total p
  CROSS JOIN average_count_value a
  WHERE a.avg_record_count IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT record_count, count_ratio, count_diff
  FROM pairs_with_average
  WHERE record_count > avg_record_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(record_count) as average_count,
  AVG(count_ratio) as average_count_to_total_ratio,
  AVG(count_diff) as average_difference
FROM filtered_pairs
